title: Sensorik announces +4.9 % on Pressure sensor 0-16 bar
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Sensorik Ammertal GmbH. Sensorik announces +4.9 % on Pressure sensor 0-16 bar. Need: 25840 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 28 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.
